title: Turtle Island Preserve

services.name: College Programs
services.desc: Day-Long and overnight visits are available to college and university groups. We have countless hands-on lessons and classes offered in Homesteading, Appalachian Lore, Permaculture, Off-Grid Living, Forest Management, Alternative Energy Sources and MUCH

blurb: Turtle Island Preserve is a 1,000-acre nature preserve near Boone, North Carolina, founded by Eustace Conway. The preserve promotes sustainable living through outdoor education, primitive skills workshops, school programs, and youth camps.
